answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Newspaper subscription tenure with delivery logs is the check: a paper delivered to one door every morning for years. The price is per head, and the haven test proves it: A farm faking 396 aliases needs 396 separate delivery logs, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The ripple trail is public, the kernel check is cheap to run, and a farm of 396 aliases pays 396 full fares while the honest agent pays one.
